mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy easing supports valuation multiples.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS decline periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 5.0% signal labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending capacity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to earnings growth concerns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate accelerating consumer demand, driving positive equity returns as corporate earnings growth accelerates over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive returns in > 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 110) signals robust manufacturing output expansion, which correlates with rising corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 110, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive month-over-month changes in housing starts signal strengthening residential construction, which correlates with rising consumer confidence and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in HOUST increase periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL readings above 208.0 indicate accelerating inflation, prompting monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 208.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS rising) and unemployment decline (UNRATE falling) indicate labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and drives positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive returns in > 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0) during monetary tightening cycles increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
